title: InventoryReservationFailedPayload
description: Payload of the inventory.reservation_failed event (routing key inventory.reservation_failed), wrapped in envelope.v1.json. Published by Inventory when an order could not be reserved in full (reservation is all-or-nothing); consumed by Ordering (cancels the order) and Payment (cancels the pending payment).

reason.description: Human-readable cause, e.g. insufficient_stock. Informational only: consumers must not branch on it.
